description: This file defines template specializations for vectorized type conversions between various data types (e.g., float, BFloat16, Half, int64_t, int32_t, int8_t, uint8_t, Float8 formats) using AVX-512 intrinsics, within the at::vec namespace for CPU vector capabilities.
published: VecConvert<dst_t, 1, src_t, 1> (specialized for floating point and 8-bit integers)
